lead.event: MSCI Indonesia reclassification proposal and market responses
lead.headline: MSCI proposes standalone status for Indonesia, risking US$5.6 billion in outflows
lead.blurb: The index provider proposed moving Indonesia directly from Emerging Market to Standalone Market status, citing concerns about investability, ownership transparency and enforcement. Goldman Sachs estimates a full removal from MSCI indexes could prompt around US$5.6 billion in passive-fund outflows. The proposal triggered an 11.6% Friday fall in the IHSG, its deepest daily drop since the 1998 Asian financial crisis. Consultation runs through 30 April 2027, with a final decision due by 30 June 2027 and implementation possible from the August 2027 review.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 5 new articles with a new fact: The IHSG fell 11.6% on Friday, its deepest daily drop since the 1998 Asian financial crisis.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX excludes high-concentration stocks from IHSG calculation
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX sets 2 November start for excluding high-concentration stocks from IHSG
market_structure_policy.blurb: The change also covers stocks on the Acceleration Board, while the index’s 9% cap remains unchanged. As of 21 October, 84 companies remained designated as high-shareholding-concentration stocks after IDX revoked three designations.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK sanctions parties in DSSA, BREN, and CUAN violations
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK imposes Rp2.1 trillion in sanctions over DSSA, BREN and CUAN violations
market_structure_policy.blurb: Penalties included Rp1.5 trillion for SMT in the DSSA case, Rp500 billion for AH Ltd in BREN and Rp100 billion for TC Pte Ltd in CUAN. A director of SS had his underwriting representative license suspended for one year. OJK announced the sanctions on 16 October and delivered the letters on 21 October.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: A PT SS director’s underwriting representative license was suspended for one year.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRI announces a Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBRI announces a second 2026 buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The plan follows a Rp500 billion buyback that ran from 12 June to 11 September. Bank Rakyat Indonesia estimates the new program will run from 22 October to 21 January 2027, funded with internal cash. Repurchased shares are intended for its management and employee stock option plan, subject to shareholder approval for their transfer.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Amman Mineral announces a Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: AMMN announces a share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Amman Mineral plans to repurchase up to 266.84 million shares, capped at 0.37% of issued and paid-up capital, through BCA Sekuritas. The buyback runs from 22 October to 22 January 2027 and will be funded entirely from internal cash, with no expected impact on operations.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: PTPP finalizes Rp18.2 trillion debt restructuring
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PTPP finalizes Rp18.2 trillion debt restructuring
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Pembangunan Perumahan’s agreement with Bank Mandiri, BRI, BNI and BSI covers principal and interest obligations as of July 2026. It took effect on 21 October, with about Rp13.33 trillion due over 15 years at 3.5% annual interest and about Rp4.05 trillion due within five years, funded by asset divestments.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati announces a share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBSS plans buyback of up to Rp200 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati plans to repurchase up to 42.17 million shares, or 2.41% of its issued shares, using internal cash. The buyback is scheduled to run from 22 October to 21 January.

earnings_guidance.headline: DCII reports nine-month revenue of Rp2.53 trillion, up 31.49%
earnings_guidance.blurb: DCI Indonesia’s gross profit rose 19.69% to Rp1.29 trillion, while operating profit increased 17.06% to Rp1.17 trillion. Net profit attributable to parent owners climbed 11.50% to Rp919.84 billion, lifting basic earnings per share to Rp386 from Rp346.

earnings_guidance.event: Unilever Indonesia reports nine-month 2026 earnings growth
earnings_guidance.headline: UNVR reports 26% nine-month profit growth to Rp4.2 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Unilever Indonesia's net sales rose 7.16% to Rp25.75 trillion, and the company recorded volume growth for five consecutive quarters. It will share further information about its Foods business before the end of 2026.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: The company recorded volume growth for five consecutive quarters.

earnings_guidance.headline: FORE reports nine-month 2026 revenue of Rp1.59 trillion, up 53.3%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Fore Kopi said EBITDA rose 70.6% to Rp342.2 billion, while net profit attributable to owners increased 49.75% to Rp90 billion. It added more than 70 outlets in the nine months, exceeding its initial 2026 target.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: EBITDA rose 70.6% to Rp342.2 billion.

earnings_guidance.headline: PTPP reports 4,576.34% nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: PP reported parent-attributable net profit of Rp259.96 billion, up from Rp5.55 billion a year earlier. Revenue fell 12.69% to Rp9.37 trillion, while basic earnings per share rose to Rp42 from Rp1.
